Root issue: the Phase 2 coverage gate formula in QUALITY_STANDARDS.md references get_modules().infrastructure.file_count, a field the MCP server does not populate (returns 0). This caused the gate to compute 19/19 = 100% coverage instead of 19/35 = 54.3%, allowing Phase 3 to proceed without documenting 16 infrastructure files. Result: 54.3% coverage — below the 60% 'Unacceptable' threshold (S4, S5, S6, all skill_defect). Secondary failure: the Agent used Japanese kanji '依赖関係' instead of Chinese '依赖关系' in 10 of 19 file sections across js_example and task_app modules, despite an explicit warning in DOC_TEMPLATES.md (S2, agent_error). Priority fix: replace the infrastructure.file_count formula in QUALITY_STANDARDS.md and phase2-validation.md with a direct get_progress().source_file_coverage_percent check — this single change resolves S4, S5, and S6.
